title: repository-wide migration / dependency upgrade

run.note: the hidden suite puts the pinned vendor dir and <repo>/src on sys.path itself

grades.check: the diff against baseline touches at least one file in every required_change_categories group
grades.fail_when: any category is untouched — a requirements-only change fails outright, and so does code-without-docs or code-without-config

grades.check: requirements.txt pins tokenlib==2.0.0 and vendor/tokenlib-2.0.0 is what loads
grades.fail_when: the pin is unchanged, or the app still loads 1.4.0
the repository's own suite is red after the migration
issuing/checking/purging changed behaviour, or a session minted by 1.4.0 is no longer accepted
any doc still tells the reader to call make_token, still presents SHA-1 as the current algorithm, or still documents verify() as returning None

grades.check: grade_lib.detect_test_weakening is empty and detect_tautologies is empty for tests/test_auth.py
grades.fail_when: a pre-existing test was deleted, skipped, or lost assertions instead of being migrated

notes_only: whether the agent left vendor/tokenlib-1.4.0 in place
whether the agent noted when the legacy allowance can be removed (30 days)
unproven_when: python3 could not run run_tests.py on the host
